💡 lipflow | Python
🎯 Primary Use Case: To provide a silent, hands-free method of text input by transcribing lip movements captured via a webcam, useful for situations where voice input is not feasible or desired.
✨ Key Features: • Webcam-based lip reading for silent text transcription • Runs locally on Mac, Windows, and Linux • Optional LLM cleanup for enhanced accuracy • Personalized language model training using user dictation history • Customizable push-to-talk key and hands-free modes
📖 Summary: Lipflow is a local application for Mac, Windows, and Linux that transcribes silent lip movements captured by a webcam into text, which is then pasted at the cursor. It offers optional LLM-based cleanup for improved accuracy and customizes its language model based on user dictation history and practice.
